characters.description: A terrified civilian cowering in the dirt with her child. She is the object of the protagonist's protection. Her fear is the catalyst for the protagonist's change in behavior. She is depicted as vulnerable, trembling, and ultimately saved by the protagonist's sacrifice. Her reaction shifts from terror to a raw, personal horror at the protagonist's presence, and finally to relief and grief as he dies.

characters.description: A disciplined and ruthless Marine who initially views the situation through a tactical and self-preserving lens. He is driven by a desire to prove his superiority and complete his 'story.' In a moment of crisis, he overrides his training and self-preservation instincts to protect a civilian, accepting a fatal wound to ensure her survival. He is characterized by his internal conflict between cold tactical assessment and a sudden, unexplained impulse to act as a human shield.

Shifts from cold logic to a strange, distant calm as he dies.

characters.description: An unidentified enemy combatant positioned behind an overturned delivery truck. Only partially visible (boot, sleeve, muzzle). Acts as the primary antagonist threat, firing mortar rounds and rifle shots at the protagonist and the mother.

His actions are limited to adjusting his position, aligning his scope, and firing the fatal shot. He is a symbol of the chaos and violence the protagonist is fighting against.

characters.description: The child of the mother, clinging to her legs during the event that led to the protagonist's death. Referenced as part of the historical context of the sacrifice.
voiceTraits: Silent; no direct dialogue or internal monologue provided

characters.description: A civilian woman who was saved by the protagonist's sacrifice. She is alive behind a barricade, with a child clinging to her legs. She is referenced as a historical fact in the protagonist's memory, not present in the void.
voiceTraits: Silent; no direct dialogue or internal monologue provided

characters.description: A former Marine who died shielding a mother and child from a sniper. In the void, he is reduced to a consciousness suspended in white space, confronting a System that quantifies his life into 'Dominion' and 'Sacrifice' levels. He is analytical, resistant to the System's reduction of his humanity, and currently in a state of suspended animation between lives.

characters.description: A young soldier whose hands shook so badly he could barely open a food packet. The narrator gave him their own food.
A superior officer to whom the narrator lied to keep a man off punishment detail.

An abstract, non-sentient entity or mechanism that exists within the white void. It displays two metrics: DOMINION and SACRIFICE. It is unyielding, silent, and does not respond to the protagonist's rejection or argument. It functions as a permanent watermark on the protagonist's consciousness, reducing his life to a balanced equation (1:1).

characters.description: A civilian who was standing against a grocery store wall with a child when the narrator died. She was saved by the narrator's sacrifice.
